trap.label: in/on/at
trap.wrong: The keys are in the table.
trap.right: The keys are on the table.
trap.why: O português "em" cobre in, on e at; em inglês on é sobre uma superfície, in é dentro e at é um ponto.

fix.wrong: The milk is on the fridge. (dentro)
fix.right: The milk is in the fridge.

fix.wrong: The keys are in the table.
fix.right: The keys are on the table.

rewrite.answer: She is at the bus stop.
The pen is on the table.
